findings.title: Aggregate OK (24 tests) does not mean 24 fully exercised test bodies
findings.detail: Original evidence.json says 24 tests pass; no skips reported. Raw log explicitly prints loaderAwareModuleResourcePathToUriRoundTripKeepsModuleAndLoader: (test requires class-loader-aware lookup to be enabled) Passed. Source line 422 uses Assume.assumeTrue. runtimeClassPathResource returns immediately unless svm.test.expectRuntimeClassPathResource is true; the logged executable command supplies only --verbose. Neither loader-aware configuration nor runtime classpath content is proven by that run. Original evidence.json preserved.

findings.title: Full authority identity is not established by this patch
findings.detail: Inherited URLStreamHandler ignores userInfo in equals/sameFile/hashCode. moduleA@app and moduleB@app with the same path compare equal in the custom handler analogue. Existing source ResourceURLConnection uses userInfo as module identity when ClassRegistries.respectClassLoader is enabled. This predates the patch, is independent of network-address equivalence, and should not block the scoped DNS/IP alias fix. A claim that all distinct textual authorities are now distinct would be inaccurate.
